articles.summary: Expert Insights and Enhanced Tools for Fantasy Football Managers USA TODAY Sports, part of USA TODAY Co., Inc. (NYSE: TDAY), has launched USA TODAY Sports Fantasy, a new fantasy subscription platform that combines expert insights, advanced projections and decision-support tools to help fantasy managers make smarter roster and lineup decisions throughout the NFL season. Seamlessly integrated into the broader USA TODAY Sports ecosystem, the platform is designed for both casual and experienced fantasy players. Available across web and mobile, USA TODAY Sports Fantasy delivers the insights and resources managers need to stay competitive every week of the football season. Subscribers gain access to a comprehensive suite of fantasy tools, including: League Sync: Connect your league to receive personalized matchup odds, optimized lineup recommendations and waiver wire pickups tailored to your roster. Rankings & Projections: Access expert rankings, advanced player projections and detailed statistical breakdowns to inform key roster decisions.
